options.label: Closures govern
options.text: Treat construction closure as controlling whenever the periods overlap.

options.label: Break hours govern
options.text: Treat the normal recess and summer operation claims as controlling during overlap.

options.label: Separate exceptions
options.text: Specify distinct overlap rules for the Campus Store and cafe.

issues.question: When construction overlaps recess or summer break, do the construction closures override the normally stated operation of the Main Building Campus Store and cafe?
issues.title: Construction overlap with break operations
issues.why_it_matters: Without an explicit governing condition, guidance can state that the same facility is both operating and closed on the same day.

analysis.overview: The frames largely complement one another: REFERENCE supplies broad campus access, venue, parking, amenity, facility, and routing guidance, while COMPARED adds construction-specific closures, substitutions, routing, and demand effects. Normal break operations conflict with construction closures for two Main Building amenities.

relations.reason: REFERENCE gives a general same-type substitution rule; COMPARED identifies construction alternatives, excludes closed facilities, and preserves the absence of a store replacement after 11 p.m.
